question: Who among the following represents the full authority of the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Speaker.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The speaker of the Lok Sabha is that the leader and also the highest authority of the **Lok Sabha, the lower house of the Parliament of India. **
 
• **The speaker** is elected generally whithin the **first meeting of the Lok Sabha following general elections. **
 
• Serving for a term of 5** years**, the speaker chosen from sitting members of the **Lok Sabha.**
 
• Parliament is that the supreme legislative body of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** President** is liable for implementing and enforcing the laws written by Congress and, to it end, appoints the heads of the federal agencies, including the **Cupboard.**
 
• The **Vice President** is additionally a part of the chief **Branch**, able to assume the Presidency should the requirement arise.
 
• The **P****rime minister acts because the leader of the house of the chamber of parliament—generally the Lok Sabha—they belongs to. **
 
• The **P****rime minister is tasked with representing the manager whithin the legislature, announces important legislation,** and is further expected to reply to the opposition's concerns.
